objects.authorized_functional_state: Y_F when current evidence supports it
objects.nuisance_state: N=(period, source, publisher, script, observation-channel metadata)

evaluation_vector: K: typed-counterfactual selectivity where R2 authority exists
D: R6 decision distortion where decision authority exists
A: adaptation cost for adaptive models
rules: No weighted scalar score is frozen.
High N is not a benefit by default; it is evidence that corpus/period/script identity is easily recoverable from Z.
C without K or D cannot establish semantic/function preservation.
Low N obtained by removing information post-hoc is not automatically good; content/decision damage must be tested.
A model may dominate in one validity region and lose in another.
Pareto incomparability is a valid terminal scientific result.
local_dominance: R_i locally dominates R_j on validity region E only if no authority-bearing coordinate is worse beyond its frozen tolerance and at least one coordinate is strictly better; nuisance risk is ordered lower-is-better only after content/decision preservation is not worse.

hybrid_state.hard_constraints: only R2 PROMOTED fields within their native validity region

no_fresh_recruitment: Existing-human provenance and public/canonical traces are exhausted first. Packet readiness does not authorize new participant recruitment.
